definitions.gloss: coordinator; mediator; go-between; person who reconciles different parties
definitions.explanation: A person whose role is to coordinate between different parties, departments, or interests, smoothing out conflicts and finding compromises. Common in business, politics, and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is active as a mediator between departments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利害|りがい}→利害：04091_rigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}する→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、{調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I ended up taking on the role of mediator between the two parties whose interests were in conflict.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧ (adjustment, coordination) and ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role, part). Describes a specific role rather than a formal job title. Often the {調整役|ちょうせいやく} is someone who takes on this function informally because of their personality, position, or relationships.

In Japanese workplaces, the {調整役|ちょうせいやく} is a highly valued role, since consensus-building (⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧) is central to Japanese organizational culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as coordinator
- {調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧: to take on the role of mediator
- {調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to take on a coordinating role
- {調整役|ちょうせいやく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a go-between

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仲介者|ちゅうかいしゃ}→仲介者：23919_chuukaisha⟧: intermediary, broker — more formal, often in legal/business deals
- {仲裁者|ちゅうさいしゃ}: arbitrator — makes binding decisions in disputes
- {世話役|せわやく}: organizer, caretaker — broader; manages practical arrangements
